desc: 🎫 Professional ticket system — panel, categories, auto-close, logs.
sUsage:
`/channels set` — Set ticket category & log channel
`/roles set type:Staff/Ticket Role` — Set staff role
`/ticket setautoclose` — Auto-close hours
`/ticket setlimit` — Max tickets per user
`/ticket config` — View config
pDesc: Need help? Select a category below to open a private ticket.
wDesc:
Hi <@{user}>, staff will assist you shortly.
**Category:** {cat}
closedLog: Ticket #{number} wrapped up | Started by <@{user}> | {cat} | Hope we helped! 💙
notSet: {warning} **Not configured.** Use `/ticket setup` → `/channels set` and `/roles set` to configure.
helpCmds:
`{prefix}ticket panel` — Post panel
`{prefix}ticket close` — Close
`{prefix}ticket config` — View config
`/channels set` — Set ticket channels
`/roles set` — Set staff role
`/ticket setautoclose` — Auto-close hours
`/ticket setlimit` — Max tickets per user
no_ratings: 🎫 No ratings yet — be the first to rate a ticket!
no_my_ratings: 🌟 You haven't rated any tickets yet — close a ticket and share your feedback!
staff_ping_msg: Hey {user}! 👋 Your ticket is live — our team has been notified and someone will be right with you. No need to ping anyone, we see you! 💙
